newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May white sugar nears resistance as NY firms.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May white sugar nears resistance as NY firms.

text.p: White sugar futures nudged upwards in another heavy trading session as the spot May contract neared a seven-week high in the little time remaining before expiry.
As in the morning, against actuals trades accounted for much of the turnover although May/August also attracted much interest as spot positions were rolled forward before expiry on April 15.

More bullish sentiment on the New York market, which pushed May raws up 23 points to an intraday high of 11.27 cents/lb, prompted steady buying in London together with selling in tandem with the strengthening values.
"There's scale selling in the May but it'll probably run out of steam if it breaks $313," said one trader.
Technically, nearby resistance on May whites is placed at $312.50, a high dating from February 20. After that, the next upside target is a reaction high of $315.00 from last October.
At 1540 GMT May stood $1.40 firmer at $312.00 and August up $1.80 at $309.50. Volume was concentrated in the front two months and amounted to a hefty 4,710 lots.

Traders said the London market was likely to see more more against actuals and crosses in the overall volume as part of the usual book-squaring before the spot May contract goes off the board next week.
Nearby positions were also higher in Paris. May and August were both $1.90 higher at $312.40 and $309.50 respectively in a total volume of 1,429 lots.
